name: Xiezhi
description: Xiezhi is a comprehensive evaluation suite designed to assess holistic domain knowledge across 516 diverse disciplines from 13 subjects. It includes multiple-choice questions and specialized subsets to evaluate performance in specialty and interdisciplinary knowledge areas.
reputation: A relatively new but increasingly cited benchmark for broad knowledge evaluation, especially in Chinese and multilingual LLM assessment settings.
notes: Covers a wide range of disciplines with a large number of questions; evaluation code and data are open sourced.
